t: A pocket gadget that reads and copies remotes, cards and tags for learning.
steps: Buy the Flipper Zero from the official Flipper store or a maker shop.
Get a microSD card, which is required and not included.
Insert the card and charge the device with the included USB-C cable.
Update to the latest firmware release from Flipper Devices.
Open the infrared menu and try the universal TV remote.
Read one of your own NFC cards and look at the saved details.
Browse the app catalog and install a community app.
Learn the radio rules for your country before using sub-GHz features.
meta: Open Board. From $35. A few stores.
